gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Lofree's cart takes 20% off this month, which puts the aluminum Lofree Flow 2 84 (page price $159.00, left out of both ChatGPT answers) at $127.20 and under the $150 line, or that Keychron's own store today sells the K3 Max at $72.49 and the K3 Ultra 8K at $98.99 rather than the $87.49 and $109.99 ChatGPT showed.
standout_why: Compared against mkbguide.com (cited), keeb-finder.com (cited), mechkeyfoundry.com and keebscout.com, which I opened and read. mkbguide shows only $/$$/$$$ tiers with no dollar figures, names the Flow 2 84 'Best overall', and never mentions Flow Lite 2, cart discounts or Black Friday. mechkeyfoundry gives list prices checked 14 October 2026 (K3 Max $109.99, Air75 V3 $139.95, Flow 2 84 $159.00) and no sale or cart price. keebscout files the Flow 2 at $199 under 'Over $150', with no dates or sellers. keeb-finder already shows $72 at Keychron for the K3 Max and $139 at NuPhy for the Air75 V3, so the Keychron half is partly covered; none of the four has the Lofree checkout totals or the K3 Ultra 8K at $98.99. Not a 3 because the two other cited pages could not be read: RTINGS returned navigation only, and the Wirecutter proxy and nytimes.com were unreachable, so the gap is unverified against them.
decides: It widens the field under $150 rather than overturning the pick. The Flow 2 84, which mkbguide ranks best overall at its $159 page price, is $127.20 at checkout on 2026-11-21 and so qualifies on the price paid; the Air75 V3 remains the dearest ChatGPT pick at $139.95 on amazon.com. Four Lofree 75% boards we link sit under the line through our link (Flow Lite 2 84 $87.20, Flow84 $95.20, Flow 2 84 and Flow 2 84 for Mac $127.20). ChatGPT's value ordering also shifts: the K3 Max is $72.49 and the K3 Ultra 8K $98.99 at Keychron, both below the Flow Lite84's $99.00 page price ChatGPT quoted. The Lofree totals depend on its Black Friday Month sale, whose end date I did not read.
